en.name: KM 212 - Portable End Milling Machine
en.description: Portable machine which works manually, ideal for end milling operations on PVC and aluminium profiles precisely.

GENERAL FEATURES: High quality end-milling operations by the manual operations
Practical cutter adjustment thanks to the spacers
Fixing the workpiece firmly thanks to the manual vertical and horizontal clamps
Profile clamping capacity : H:80x W:160 mm
Max. end-milling capacity : H: 80 x W: 45 mm
Maximum cutter diameter (D x d): Ø 120 x d Ø 30 mm
